result.description:
We are looking for a skilled and detail-focused Statistician to contribute to active research projects in the physical, life, and/or socioeconomic sciences. In this role, you will deliver expert statistical analysis and technical support, including designing data collection protocols, managing and manipulating datasets, system programming, and producing insightful reports. Your contributions will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and value of critical research outcomes.

Duties and Responsibilities

Plans and documents computer data file structures; develops, programmes, manages, and maintains complex statistical databases; performs or supervises data entry.
Selects data samples, prepares questionnaires and surveys, and conducts logic checks to uphold data quality.
Uses established statistical software and a range of standard methods to gather, analyse, and interpret data for research applications.
Formats data and prepares reports, charts, tables, and related visual materials to communicate findings.
Collaborates with fellow statisticians in designing studies, developing statistical methodology, and executing data analysis.
Assists with project planning and coordination alongside clients and internal teams.
May supervise students or data entry personnel on assigned research tasks.
Performs other job-related duties as required.
Minimum Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree; minimum of 2 years’ experience in a role directly aligned with the listed duties and responsibilities.
Additional completed degrees from accredited institutions may be considered as equivalent experience on a year-for-year basis.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required

Proficient in designing, programming, and managing complex statistical databases.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Skilled in applying statistical techniques to support scientific research and data modelling.
Competent in data formatting, reporting, and interpretation.
Understanding of programming logic and data structures.
Familiarity with statistical sampling and survey methodology.
Experienced with tools such as SAS or similar statistical software.
Competent with common software such as databases, spreadsheets, word processors, and presentation tools.
Deep knowledge of statistical research processes, methods, and best practices.
Distinguishing Characteristics

Applies statistical software to derive meaningful insights from research data.
Designs, develops, and maintains complex statistical databases.
Translates analytical results into professional reports and presentations.
Contributes to the planning and execution of study design and data strategy.
Working Conditions and Physical Effort

Minimal physical effort required.
Minimal exposure to physical risks.
Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment.
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + Super
result.title: Statistician

result.description:
Grounded Construction Group is currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Road Roller Operator to join their team in Muchea WA.


The Road Roller Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of road rollers to compact soil, gravel, asphalt and other construction materials for roads, hardstands, building platforms and civil infrastructure works. The role is responsible for achieving specified compaction standards while maintaining compliance with company, client and legislative requirements.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Operate road rollers safely and efficiently to compact soil, gravel, crushed rock, asphalt and other construction materials. 
-  Achieve specified compaction standards for roads, hardstands, building pads, foundations and civil infrastructure. 
-  Compact fill layers in accordance with project specifications and engineering requirements. 
-  Perform rolling operations for pavement construction, roadworks, drainage and site preparation activities. 
-  Read and work from construction drawings, survey pegs, compaction specifications and supervisor instructions.
